verification_note: Maharashtra is a fully segregated code path. Its shops-and-establishments framework was re-enacted in 2017 and diverges structurally from the 1988-era statutes of Telangana and Andhra Pradesh.

instruments.title: Maharashtra Shops and Establishments (Regulation of Employment and Conditions of Service) Act, 2017

obligations.summary: Establishments register or file intimation depending on worker count under the 2017 framework — a different structure from the 1988-era Acts used in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh.
Hours, leave, weekly offs and facilities obligations follow Maharashtra rules.

instruments.title: Maharashtra State Tax on Professions, Trades, Callings and Employments Act, 1975
instruments.authority: Department of Goods and Services Tax, Government of Maharashtra

obligations.summary: Maharashtra operates separate enrolment and registration certificates with their own filing calendar.

instruments.title: Bombay Labour Welfare Fund Act, 1953 (as applicable in Maharashtra)

obligations.summary: Welfare fund contributions follow the Maharashtra board's half-yearly cycle.

instruments.title: Maharashtra Industry, Trade and Investment Facilitation Cell (MAITRI) clearance framework

obligations.summary: State industrial clearances route through Maharashtra's own facilitation cell.

state_escalation_triggers: Applying a Telangana or Andhra Pradesh shops-and-establishments template to a Maharashtra workplace — the governing Act is a different, later statute.
Opening a second office in Maharashtra while running payroll registered in another state.
